title: Duality on the projective line
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field. For every coherent
$\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^1_k}$-module $\mathcal G$, with

$$
\omega_{\mathbf P^1}:=\Omega^1_{\mathbf P^1_k/k}\cong\mathcal O(-2)
$$

([def-sc-kahler-differentials],
[lem-sc-p1-monomial](iii)), there are canonical isomorphisms

$$
H^1(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal G)^{\vee}\;\cong\;
\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^1}}\bigl(\mathcal G,
\omega_{\mathbf P^1}\bigr),
$$

$$
H^0(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal G)^{\vee}\;\cong\;
\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathbf P^1}\bigl(\mathcal G,
\omega_{\mathbf P^1}\bigr)
$$

(with $\operatorname{Ext}$ of [def-sc-ext-sheaf]; all groups
involved are finite-dimensional by [lem-pc-coherent-hi], the cohomology of coherent modules
on a proper scheme over a field being finite-dimensional: *Source:
Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Tag 02O5*).

proof.text: *Step 1: the twisted structure sheaves.* Fix the trace $t:H^1(\mathbf P^1_k,\omega)\to k$ by the chosen identification $\omega\cong\mathcal O(-2)$ and $t([t^{-1}])=1$, and use the maps $\alpha_{\mathcal G}$ and $\beta_{\mathcal G}$ defined for every $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^1_k}$-module in [lem-sc-p1-duality-pairing-naturality]. For $\mathcal G=\mathcal O(d)$, a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal O(d)\to\omega\cong\mathcal O(-2)$ is multiplication by a section of $\mathcal O(-2-d)$: the twists of [def-sc-p1-standard] are invertible by [lem-sc-p1-twist-exists], with inverse $\mathcal O(-d)$. Therefore $H^1(\varphi)$ multiplies each Cech cochain component by that section, and $\alpha_{\mathcal O(d)}$ is exactly the multiplication pairing of [lem-pc-projective-space-serre-pairing], followed by $t$. For $d\le-2$, [lem-sc-p1-monomial](ii) gives the basis $[t^j]$, $d+1\le j\le-1$, of $H^1(\mathcal O(d))$; the sections $x_0^{j-d-1}x_1^{-1-j}$ of $\mathcal O(-2-d)$ pair with these as dual bases. Thus $\alpha_{\mathcal O(d)}$ is an isomorphism. For $d\ge-1$, both its source and target vanish by [lem-sc-p1-monomial](i),(ii). For $\beta_{\mathcal O(d)}$, [lem-sc-ext-locally-free] identifies $\operatorname{Ext}^1(\mathcal O(d),\omega)$ with $H^1(\mathcal O(-2-d))$. The naturality of this identification in its locally free first argument, including pullback along $s:\mathcal O\to\mathcal O(d)$, is [lem-sc-p1-ext-locally-free-naturality]; hence $\beta_{\mathcal O(d)}(e)(s)=t(e\circ s)$ is the same Cech multiplication pairing $H^0(\mathcal O(d))\times H^1(\mathcal O(-2-d))\to H^1(\omega)\xrightarrow{t}k$. It is perfect for $d\ge0$ by [lem-pc-projective-space-serre-pairing], and for $d<0$ both sides vanish by [lem-sc-p1-monomial](i),(ii). Finite direct sums preserve these maps and isomorphisms, so both maps are isomorphisms for every finite sum of twists $\mathcal E$.

*Step 2: devissage with one family of maps.* For every coherent $\mathcal G$, use the maps $\alpha_{\mathcal G}$ and $\beta_{\mathcal G}$ of [lem-sc-p1-duality-pairing-naturality], with the fixed trace from Step 1. Choose $0\to\mathcal E_2\to\mathcal E_1\to\mathcal E_0\to\mathcal G\to0$ by [lem-sc-p1-graded-resolution] and put $\mathcal K=\operatorname{coker}(\mathcal E_2\to\mathcal E_1)$. This gives $0\to\mathcal E_2\to\mathcal E_1\to\mathcal K\to0$ and $0\to\mathcal K\to\mathcal E_0\to\mathcal G\to0$. For either short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$, [lem-sc-p1-hi-vanishing] gives $H^2(\mathcal A)=0$, so the cohomology sequence dualizes over $k$ to the exact row $$0\to H^1(\mathcal C)^\vee\to H^1(\mathcal B)^\vee\to H^1(\mathcal A)^\vee\to H^0(\mathcal C)^\vee\to H^0(\mathcal B)^\vee\to H^0(\mathcal A)^\vee\to0.$$ The higher Ext vanishing [lem-sc-p1-ext-coherent-dim-one-vanishing] gives the exact row $$0\to\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal C,\omega)\to\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal B,\omega)\to\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal A,\omega)\to\operatorname{Ext}^1(\mathcal C,\omega)\to\operatorname{Ext}^1(\mathcal B,\omega)\to\operatorname{Ext}^1(\mathcal A,\omega)\to0.$$ Put the Ext row above the dual cohomology row. Naturality and the connecting-square identity $\beta_{\mathcal C}\circ\partial_E=(\partial_H)^\vee\circ\alpha_{\mathcal A}$ of [lem-sc-p1-duality-pairing-naturality] make the six vertical maps, in order, $\alpha_{\mathcal C},\alpha_{\mathcal B},\alpha_{\mathcal A},\beta_{\mathcal C},\beta_{\mathcal B},\beta_{\mathcal A}$ a commuting diagram. For $(\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C)=(\mathcal E_2,\mathcal E_1,\mathcal K)$, columns 2, 3, 5 and 6 are isomorphisms by Step 1, so [lem-sc-four-lemma] gives $\alpha_{\mathcal K}$ and $\beta_{\mathcal K}$. Repeat with $(\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C)=(\mathcal K,\mathcal E_0,\mathcal G)$; columns 2, 3, 5 and 6 are isomorphisms by Step 1 and the first application, so the same lemma gives $\alpha_{\mathcal G}$ and $\beta_{\mathcal G}$. Their inverses are the two isomorphisms in the statement.

split_report.summary: Repaired the projective-line duality split by specifying one Yoneda-defined family alpha and beta, proving those exact maps invertible on twists via the Cech pairing and naturality of locally free Ext, and applying the commuting connecting-square identity during devissage. Corrected the Stacks source of higher Ext vanishing.
split_report.blueprint: The two steps realize Step 1 (twisted structure sheaves) and Step 2 (devissage) of blueprint node thm-sc-p1-duality, order 696.

tool_uses.why: Step 1 uses the existence and invertibility of the twist line bundles; the duality unit does not provide this construction.
Step 2 uses H^q(P^1,F)=0 for q>=2 to truncate the cohomology sequence; this vanishing is supplied by the coherence unit.
